meta.note: Every check starts not_run. Statuses: pass, fail, blocked, not_run.

checks.title: Preserve and reproduce the actual baseline
checks.method: Inspect git status and branch graph; clean install and run existing check commands without modifying guards.
checks.required_evidence: Commit SHA, dirty-tree handling, command logs and observed failures.

evidence.note: baseline reproduced on 6 branches in clean worktrees; exact commands/exit codes/logs in .orchestration/inventory.md §8 and evidence/F00/checks/results.json; pre-existing failures recorded (main/guide/video fail lint/typecheck/build due to film/; protections:check blocked (no gh/token); launch:check blocked by design; e2e only under substitute Chromium 141). F03 re-runs BASE01 on the selected integration baseline.

checks.title: No regressions in chosen site
checks.method: Exercise both language routes and existing guide/journey/contact paths at supported widths.
checks.required_evidence: Before/after screenshots, browser logs and regression results.

checks.title: No unauthorized operational data access
checks.method: Attempt anonymous and other-identity reads/writes of contacts, orders, rights and jobs.
checks.required_evidence: Denied access tests plus RLS/grant review.

checks.title: No secrets in client/source/artifacts
checks.method: Scan bundle, source, exports, logs and screenshots; inspect public environment prefix use.
checks.required_evidence: Scanner output and manually inspected bundles.

checks.title: Verified ingress and validation
checks.method: Send invalid signatures, stale/replayed requests, oversized/malformed bodies and foreign-origin form posts.
checks.required_evidence: HTTP results and unchanged durable state.

checks.title: Staging stays separate and private
checks.method: Access staging without credentials and test callback-specific verification; compare provider/database IDs.
checks.required_evidence: Access tests, configuration names, recipient allowlist evidence.

checks.title: No privilege escalation through agent or content input
checks.method: Inject instructions/URLs into RSS, forms and notes; verify data never becomes commands or new tool authority.
checks.required_evidence: Adversarial fixtures and resulting safe behavior.

checks.title: n8n loopback and TLS
checks.method: Inspect compose/ss/docker ports and external probes; inspect proxy and HTTPS chain.
checks.required_evidence: Only intended public ports; hostname and editor authentication evidence.

checks.title: Pinned supported n8n setup
checks.method: Resolve exact official image tag/digest and version-supported variables; validate Compose and start clean.
checks.required_evidence: Image digest, version, startup logs and Compose validation.

checks.title: Encryption key recovery works
checks.method: Restore encrypted credentials into isolated instance using separate backed-up original key.
checks.required_evidence: Isolated decryption/use evidence without exposing values.

checks.title: Consistent nightly backup and retention
checks.method: Run backup twice, inject failure, verify data/exports/checksums and fourteen successful daily sets.
checks.required_evidence: Manifests, failure alert and retained known-good snapshot.

checks.title: Off-host restore and update rollback
checks.method: Restore to separate blocked-egress environment; exercise pinned update and failed health check.
checks.required_evidence: Measured recovery, compatible version/data pair and no real side effects.

checks.title: Supabase restore and media separation
checks.method: Restore database/schema and required object manifest into isolated test project/store.
checks.required_evidence: Counts/checksums, RLS restored and object availability.

checks.title: No production first-boot takeover
checks.method: Verify owner setup is inaccessible to arbitrary internet user until legitimate owner establishes account.
checks.required_evidence: Bootstrap access procedure and authentication check.

checks.title: Units and missingness
checks.method: Test zero versus unknown, month/year conversion, household basis, invalid numbers and field limits.
checks.required_evidence: Independent deterministic unit fixtures.

checks.title: Inflation and timing math
checks.method: Test zero inflation/return, known closed forms, later starts, start/end-year conventions and nominal/real handling.
checks.required_evidence: Independently computed fixtures and tolerance results.

checks.title: No false sufficiency verdict
checks.method: Use gross/net mismatch, incomplete income, housing-only wealth and overlapping pension asset/income cases.
checks.required_evidence: Explicit warnings/no verdict; reviewer output.

checks.title: Private figures remain local
checks.method: Enter synthetic distinctive amounts; inspect all requests, analytics, errors, logs and storage.
checks.required_evidence: Network capture proves no amounts/derived financial profile leaves browser.

checks.title: Navigate/edit/reset
checks.method: Complete, go back, edit, skip, refresh and reset; test optional local-save expiry/shared-device disclosure.
checks.required_evidence: State-machine/browser test results.

checks.title: Branch precedence and truthful media
checks.method: Test all clip-rule overlaps and fallback; verify disclosure and actual media/captions.
checks.required_evidence: Rule matrix, playable IDs and no false personal-review copy.

checks.title: Useful independent summary
checks.method: Finish without email or booking and print/export; inspect assumptions and accessible data.
checks.required_evidence: Readable local summary/PDF/print and no mandatory upsell.

checks.title: Phone and desktop accessibility
checks.method: Keyboard, focus, screen-reader spot test, contrast, zoom, reduced motion, 320/390/768/1440 widths.
checks.required_evidence: Screenshots, a11y scan and manual walkthrough notes.

checks.title: Real iPhone Safari walkthrough
checks.method: Use actual available iPhone Safari for video/form/print/booking; if unavailable record blocked not pass.
checks.required_evidence: Device/version, steps and observed issues.

checks.title: Professional ink family
checks.method: Render all eight in context and mobile crops; inspect perspective, hatching and accidental artifacts.
checks.required_evidence: Approved contact sheet, source files, alt text and rights manifest.

checks.title: Real approved recordings
checks.method: Compare manifest against supplied Bill recordings, rights, transcripts and actual clip durations.
checks.required_evidence: Playable files, checksums, caption checks and permission refs.

checks.title: Bandwidth/playback behavior
checks.method: Measure real encode sizes; test seek/range, buffering, no-autoplay audio and caption behavior.
checks.required_evidence: Media-origin test and usage estimate.

checks.title: Correct event details and private invites
checks.method: Register external test guests in chosen language; verify time zone/link/ICS/cap; inspect recipient visibility.
checks.required_evidence: Received individual invitations and no exposed guest list.

checks.title: Fair cases and scoring
checks.method: Independently solve all ten cases from disclosed facts; check sources and hidden-reveal scoring.
checks.required_evidence: Answer-key audit and timed rehearsal.

checks.title: Meet works for external attendees
checks.method: Test outside-organization phone/desktop guest, host/moderator, polls/chat and recording disclosure.
checks.required_evidence: Actual tenant/feature evidence and rehearsal checklist.

checks.title: Attendance truthfulness
checks.method: Exercise registered, join_clicked, verified attended and unknown states.
checks.required_evidence: No-show branch never inferred from missing/unavailable evidence.

checks.title: Delivery not just API acceptance
checks.method: Send approved test messages to allowlisted inboxes; verify headers, body, language, links and actual receipt.
checks.required_evidence: Provider ID plus inbox evidence, no exposed credentials.

checks.title: No silent marketing enrolment
checks.method: Request PDF/event without opt-in and separately opt in; inspect eligibility and records.
checks.required_evidence: Consent fixtures and no unauthorized promotional sends.

checks.title: Unsubscribe wins races
checks.method: Withdraw consent while a job is queued/leased; upsert contact after blocklist and retry old job.
checks.required_evidence: Suppressed send, no automatic resubscribe and audit record.

checks.title: Shared quota and expired reminders
checks.method: Forecast overlapping campaigns; force 429/daily cap/restart and event-time expiry.
checks.required_evidence: Priority/cap behavior, no overdue reminder and operator alert.

checks.title: No duplicate send on uncertain timeout
checks.method: Simulate provider accepted request then response lost; restart worker and reconcile.
checks.required_evidence: Stored provider/job state, documented uncertainty handling.

checks.title: Import works in selected n8n version
checks.method: Import each disabled export and validate credentials/nodes manually with fixtures.
checks.required_evidence: Actual workflow IDs, version and import logs.

checks.title: Atomic job claim and retry
checks.method: Run simultaneous worker claims, replay same source event, crash mid-job and re-run.
checks.required_evidence: Unique event/job rows, lease recovery and bounded retries.

checks.title: Smoke integrations work
checks.method: Run RSS-to-email and authenticated Telegram webhook to approved test recipients; test failure cases.
checks.required_evidence: Imported workflow IDs, actual received messages and safe rejection.

checks.title: Manual fallback reconciles
checks.method: Use documented manual fulfilment/booking/posting path; record ID; resume automation.
checks.required_evidence: No duplicate or lost action after operator reconciliation.

checks.title: Payment truth and deduplication
checks.method: Replay signed paid webhook; send redirect-only and unpaid/failed/asynchronous fixtures.
checks.required_evidence: No entitlement until verified paid; one right/order.

checks.title: Rights redemption and rescheduling
checks.method: Redeem another identity, expired/used token, duplicate request and valid buyer reschedule.
checks.required_evidence: Unauthorized denied; existing right preserved once.

checks.title: Refund/cap/fulfilment consistency
checks.method: Test approved refund behavior, stock/calendar cap and dispatch failure.
checks.required_evidence: Correct rights/fulfilment ledger and no fabricated shipment.

checks.title: Actual calendar is authoritative
checks.method: Book/cancel/reschedule with cross-calendar conflict, buffer, DST and online/in-person variants.
checks.required_evidence: Provider event IDs and no double-booked slot.

checks.title: No false conversion from clicks
checks.method: Visit scheduling page without booking; reconcile actual test booking and cancellation.
checks.required_evidence: Only actual event/operator evidence changes booked state.

checks.title: Inventory exists and is substantive
checks.method: Count and read all required scripts/briefs/templates/drawings, not filenames only.
checks.required_evidence: Asset manifest with completeness review.

checks.title: No fabricated Bill claims
checks.method: Check every client anecdote, experience/designation, first-person philosophy and promise against approved sources.
checks.required_evidence: Claim ledger and flagged/removed unsupported copy.

checks.title: Financial claims are current and reviewed
checks.method: Follow primary sources for jurisdiction/date; independently check arithmetic and meaning.
checks.required_evidence: Source ledger and real reviewer approval refs.

checks.title: Bilingual meaning and natural voice
checks.method: Read scripts aloud; verify FR/EN terms, offer durations and unsupported overclaims.
checks.required_evidence: Bill/reviewer notes and matched versions.

checks.title: Approval hashes cannot be bypassed
checks.method: Modify approved title/body/claim/clip and try publishing; edit approval ledger as worker.
checks.required_evidence: Release blocked; only genuine latest approvals accepted.

checks.title: Weekly publication is controlled
checks.method: Run draft job twice, reject draft, expire approval, fail deploy and fail LinkedIn publish.
checks.required_evidence: One draft/week, no unauthorized publication, ready-to-post fallback.

checks.title: Public content is crawlable and truthful
checks.method: Check robots/canonicals/hreflang/sitemap/status/structured data and protected drafts.
checks.required_evidence: HTTP/schema results and correct indexing boundaries.

checks.title: Current category/permissions verified
checks.method: Review current official/account-specific rules and permitted targeting, creative and audiences.
checks.required_evidence: Dated operator/account evidence; no unsupported age-targeting claim.

checks.title: No financial tracking leakage
checks.method: Inspect pixel/server events before/after consent, route and payload allowlists.
checks.required_evidence: No financial inputs, hidden personal profiling or unauthorized tags.

checks.title: Budget and destinations match approval
checks.method: Test every ad CTA; compare active scope/spend cap to human authorization.
checks.required_evidence: Approved campaign IDs, working destinations and cap evidence.

checks.title: Fail safely during outages
checks.method: Disable email/DB/media/integration in staging and interrupt deployment.
checks.required_evidence: Helpful user states, durable accepted work or honest retry error, no fake success.

checks.title: Actionable operator report
checks.method: Seed pending rights/orders, provider failures, quota warnings and booking gaps.
checks.required_evidence: One readable report with owner, event ID and next action.

checks.title: Privacy and deletion procedure
checks.method: Exercise access/deletion with order/consent retention constraints in fictional data.
checks.required_evidence: Approved retention behavior, minimal suppression retained appropriately.

checks.title: Manifest/rollback match tested version
checks.method: Compare artifact hashes, approved media, migrations, workflow versions and active flags.
checks.required_evidence: Signed/scoped human release ref and reproducible rollback.

checks.title: End-to-end invited pilot
checks.method: An external tester completes guide, workshop, event join, booking and test book path.
checks.required_evidence: Timestamped user journey evidence and fixed P0/P1 findings.

checks.title: Weekly metrics reflect real outcomes
checks.method: Reconcile provider/calendar/operator outcomes to source cohorts; show unknown attendance.
checks.required_evidence: Held-meeting counts and denominators without invented conversion results.

checks.title: One measured change with limits
checks.method: Review 30/60/90-day cohorts and actual time/cost; approve one experiment at a time.
checks.required_evidence: Decision log, actual budget and no autonomous spend increase.

checks.title: Owner can operate and recover
checks.method: Run an owner walkthrough, renewals review, rights/keys transfer and isolated recovery.
checks.required_evidence: Owner acceptance, revoked temporary access and complete runbooks.
